clinical_trials: Holds clinical trial records; one row per trial (id) with identifiers/metadata (id, title, brief_title, acronym, registry, linkout, start_date, end_date, start_year, end_year), descriptive fields (abstract, phase, overall_status, study_type, study_designs, study_arms, study_outcome_measures), participant/eligibility attributes (gender, study_participants, study_eligibility_criteria, study_minimum_age, study_maximum_age), topical/classification fields (conditions, interventions, mesh_terms, concepts, category_bra, category_for, category_hra, category_hrcs_hc, category_hrcs_rac), contributors/organizations (investigators, researcher_ids, research_orgs, organisation_details, funder_orgs, associated_grant_ids), publication/linking fields (publication_ids, linkout), and administrative/temporal metrics (start_year, end_year, active_years, funding_details).
grid: Holds GRID organization records; one row per organization (id) with current status and identifier/redirects (id, status, redirect, external_ids), names and labels (name, aliases, acronyms, labels), dates (established, closed), contact/links (email_address, links, wikipedia_url, address), types and relationships (types, relationships) and other metadata.
grants: Holds grant/award records; one row per grant (id) with identifiers and titles (id, title, grant_number, foa_number, linkout), descriptive text (abstract, original_title, original_abstract, language), dates/temporal fields (start_date, end_date, start_year, end_year, active_years), financial measures (funding_amount, funding_currency, funding_aud, funding_cad, funding_chf, funding_eur, funding_gbp, funding_jpy, funding_nzd, funding_usd, funding_cny), contributors and organizations (investigators, researcher_ids, research_orgs, organisation_details), geographic/org aggregates (research_org_cities, research_org_state_codes, research_org_countries, funder_org, funder_org_cities, funder_org_state_codes, funder_org_countries), topical/classification (concepts, category_bra, category_for, category_hra) and linking fields (associated_grant_ids?).
datasets: Holds dataset records; one row per dataset (id) with identifiers and locations (id, doi, repository_url, repository_id, repository_name), descriptive metadata (title, description, citation_string, authors, license), dates (created_date, embargo_date, date, date_modified, date_imported_gbq, year), links to publications/grants (associated_publication_doi, associated_publication_pmid, associated_publication_arxiv_id, associated_publication_id, associated_grant_ids), organizational/contributor fields (research_orgs, researcher_ids, research_org_cities, research_org_countries, research_org_state_codes), and many classification/category fields (category_bra, category_for, category_hra, category_hrcs_hc, category_hrcs_rac, category_icrp_cso, category_icrp_ct, category_rcdc, category_sdg, category_uoa, categories).
publications: Holds publication records; one row per publication (id) with bibliographic identifiers and dates (id, doi, pmid, pmcid, arxiv_id, date, date_online, date_print, year, volume, issue, pages), textual metadata (abstract, subtitles, acknowledgements, funding_section, copyright_statement, publisher), type/venue fields (type, book_title, book_series_title, proceedings_title, conference), open-access and repository links (open_access_categories, open_access_categories_v2, repository_dois, resulting_publication_doi), contributors/references (editors, reference_ids), topical indexing (mesh_headings, mesh_terms) and classification tags (category_bra, category_for, category_hra, category_hrcs_hc, category_hrcs_rac, category_icrp_cso, category_icrp_ct).
patents: Holds patent records; one row per patent/document (id) with identifiers and dates (id, kind, jurisdiction, application_number, family_id, publication_date, filing_date, priority_date, granted_date, expiration_date), legal/status fields (filing_status, legal_status, legal_events), assignees/inventors (inventor_names, current_assignee, original_assignee, assignee_orgs, current_assignee_orgs, original_assignee_orgs, researcher_ids), descriptive metadata (title, abstract, concepts, categories, categories including category_bra, category_for, category_hra, category_hrcs_hc, category_hrcs_rac, category_icrp_cso, category_icrp_ct, category_rcdc, category_sdg, category_uoa), classification codes (cpc, ipcr), linking/reference fields (reference_ids, family_id), regulatory/health fields (orange_book, federal_support) and funding information (funding_details).
